step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number for the request:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .
Go to step 15.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work Type: Select 42 - Working While on Claim – Reversion .

Remarks:
Remarks line 1: Type “Apply the provisions of Pilot Project 17 as of w/c XXXX.”
Remarks line 2: Type the appropriate option:
“no impact.”
“net underpayment.”
“net overpayment — including net overpayment amount.”
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - Entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-Fraud - Earnings and Employment .
Message: Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the AI WI for the issue.
